'''''The Wheel of Time''''' is a historical work produced by Sulamein so Bhagad, the Chief Historian at the [[Court of the Sun]] in the [[Fourth Age]].

{{quote|And when the blood was sprinkled on ground where nothing could grow, the [[Children of the Dragon]] did spring up, the [[People of the Dragon]], armed to dance with death. And he did call them forth from [[Aiel Waste|the wasted lands]], and they did shake the world with battle.<br />
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;-from </i>The Wheel of Time<i><br />
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;by Sulamein so Bhagad<br />
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Chief Historian at the Court of the Sun,<br />
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;the Fourth Age|{{4|58}}}}
